name: Garikon School ERP
desc: Enterprise multi-tenant school administration suite engineered with role-based access control (RBAC), academic grading engines, student portals, and real-time M-Pesa automated fee billing reconciliation.
impact: Automated M-Pesa fee billing for 1,000+ students, reconciled as payments come in.

name: Digital LMS Platform
desc: Unified learning management platform designed for multi-portal academic institutions. Features real-time assessment modules, automated grade computations, instructor portals, and student course tracking.
impact: Inertia.js SPA, so navigation and grade updates happen without page reloads.

name: Bulk Email & Automation Platform
desc: High-throughput campaign automation backend hosted on AWS infrastructure. Implements asynchronous Celery/worker queues, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and environment configuration management.
impact: 50,000+ emails sent through Celery worker queues, with delivery tracking per send.

name: MPESA Spending Analyzer
desc: Personal finance analytics engine scanning M-Pesa SMS confirmation payloads. Employs regex parsing and categorization algorithms to generate interactive spending trends, merchant analytics, and budgeting reports.
impact: M-Pesa SMS data stays on the phone, so no transaction history ever leaves it.

name: Python ML Plant Disease Predictor
desc: Computer vision inference engine built to diagnose crop diseases directly from leaf imagery. Built on convolutional neural networks with lightweight web deployment for low-bandwidth farming environments.
impact: Trained CNN hits 94% accuracy on crop-disease photos, light enough for slow connections.

name: Warehouse & Inventory System
desc: Enterprise hardware-software telemetry bridge integrating RFID scanners with a high-concurrency Node.js event backend for live inventory movement logging and automated audit trails.
impact: RFID scans log inventory movements in real time; audit trails are automatic.

name: Ocean Climate Hub
desc: Interactive research portal communicating ocean climate dynamics, marine ecosystem indicators, and blue economy metrics with rich visual infographics.
impact: Interactive dashboards that make ocean climate data readable for researchers and the public.

name: Torchbearer Technologies
desc: Corporate technical portal engineered for Torchbearer Technologies showcasing renewable energy, solar infrastructure, and high-voltage HVAC engineering systems.
impact: The company's main site, with clear service pages and an inquiry form that reaches the team.

name: Kenstane Energy Platform
desc: Clean-tech web architecture showcasing commercial solar deployments, ROI calculators, and client engagement channels for a leading sustainable energy provider.
impact: Static-first React build deployed straight to Vercel's edge network.

name: Airbnb Platform Suite
desc: Accommodation reservation portal featuring interactive map clustering, date-range booking workflows, filterable amenities, and dynamic state management.
impact: Property filters and map clustering update results live as options change.

name: Hadria E-Commerce Suite
desc: Robust e-commerce store architecture with relational inventory schemas, session-based cart states, and modular checkout pipeline with secure payment processing.
impact: Cart, checkout, and invoicing share one relational flow with payment gateway integration.

name: Wordmaster Game
desc: High-performance interactive linguistic puzzle engineered with reactive keyboard event listeners, dictionary validation algorithms, and state history tracking.
impact: Game logic has no dependencies; keyboard input responds in under 5ms.
